content.text:
Toasters, Data Centers, and an Unassuming Box That’s Boosting 3 Power Stocks
Let’s run through some basics, including neoclouds, brownfield construction, watts versus volts, and how to not accidentally set off a plasma blowtorch hotter than the surface of the sun. A good place to start is toasters.
